children: Basis bids for corn and soybeans shipped by barge to the US Gulf were mixed on Tuesday and export premiums were flat, brokers said.

US corn futures jumped on Tuesday after the US Department of Agriculture announced a bigger-than-expected cut in its condition rating for the crop, which stoked worries that the agency would trim its yield outlook.
Soybean futures also gained as harvesting was slowed by recent rains which have also sparked concerns about crop quality and oil content.

Chicago Board of Trade November soybeans (SX26) settled Chicago Board of Trade December corn (CZ26) ended 10-3/4 cents higher at $5.08 a bushel, while November soybeans (SX26) gained 22-1/4 cents to end at $13.03 a bushel.
